text: 国家发展改革委今天表示，从今年的情况看，我国集成电路产业发展呈现四方面突出特点。一是关键核心技术不断取得突破。二是企业竞争力持续增强。三是产能利用率保持高位。四是产业链安全水平显著提升。下一步将继续聚焦“十五五”规划《纲要》部署要求，发挥新型举国体制优势，全链条推动集成电路关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破，促进集成电路产业高质量发展，为推动中国经济持续向新向优向好发展做出更大贡献。（央视财经）
text_en: The NDRC said today that looking at this year, China's integrated circuit industry shows four prominent features: first, continuous breakthroughs in core technologies; second, steadily rising corporate competitiveness; third, high capacity utilization; and fourth, significantly improved supply chain security. Next steps will focus on the requirements of the 15th Five-Year Plan outline, leverage the advantages of the new nationwide system for key technological breakthroughs, advance decisive progress in core technology of integrated circuits across the full chain, promote high-quality development of the integrated circuit industry, and contribute to China's sustained shift toward a newer, stronger and better economy. (CCTV Finance)
